title: Editorial policies and guidelines carry a language
description:
As a publication editor, I want each language of a publication checked against its own rules and voice, so a Chinese or Spanish Story is never judged by English phrase rules.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-multilingual-humanus-design.md section 2.4. `EditorialPolicy` gains a required `language` (`*` for neutral); `compose_pack` selects the Story's language; the publication's voice is written once and applies everywhere; a language overlay (guideline kind `writing`, scope `language:<tag>`) holds only what is specific to the language, including the target locale's conventions of naming, register and press norms (Ryan 2026-11-13), expressed through the overlay and the per-language glossary and pack, never by omitting or altering a factual claim. Spanish and Chinese starter packs are built together.

```gherkin
Feature: Each language of a publication is checked against its own rules
  Scenario: A Chinese Story is not checked against English phrase rules
    Given a publication with English and Chinese policies
    When a Chinese localization is checked
    Then only Chinese and language-neutral policies run
    And the check result names the language pack and its version

  Scenario: The publication's voice applies in every language
    Given the publication's writing guidelines set the audience and constraints
    And a Chinese overlay adds register notes and words to avoid
    When the guidelines are resolved for a Chinese Story in the Security section
    Then the answer has the publication's constraints, the section's guidance and the Chinese notes
    And says which layer each part came from

  Scenario: The target locale's conventions come from the overlay and never change a fact
    Given the Chinese overlay records the locale's convention for naming an organisation
    When a Chinese localization is translated and checked
    Then the convention is applied through the glossary and overlay
    And every factual claim of the English Story is still present

  Scenario: Turning on a language brings its starter rules
    Given a site that enables Simplified Chinese
    Then the Chinese typography, translationese and AI-tells starter policies exist for that site
    And the Spanish starter policies exist when Spanish is enabled
```
